common: Animate only the illustrated square in the middle of the vertical black canvas; keep its exact size, position and all black margins. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no crop. Preserve the hand-drawn ink illustration style, faces, clothes, hands and props exactly. Subtle natural motion only. No new people or objects, no text, no letters, no subtitles, no watermark. Silent.

shots.action: He listens on the phone, eyes widen slightly, then he nods once.
The friend hands back the envelope with a grateful smile and a small bow; he takes it and smiles.
The friend presses the phone to his ear, glances around anxiously and runs a hand through his hair.
The friend lowers his head further; the other man exhales and looks at his soju glass. The bulb flickers softly.
He stares at the bankbook, swallows, then glances toward the sleeping wife in the background.
He reads his phone, his face falls slowly, he lowers his eyes. Bare branches sway lightly.
The thumb hovers and moves slightly over the blank screen, the hand trembles a little.
He rubs his temple slowly and glances at the framed photo; the desk lamp glows steadily.
The tent canvas moves gently in the wind; the liquid in the full glass shimmers slightly. No people appear.
